contextBody: Province-wide public-body CCTV guidelines from the provincial privacy commissioner cover necessity, camera locations/times, authorized viewing, storage and retention. Public works safety specifications are examples, not claims about every private premise.
sourceTitle: OIPC Guidelines for Video Surveillance by Public Bodies in Newfoundland and Labrador

cctv.heading: CCTV planning and privacy
cctv.body: For public bodies consider purpose, proportionate camera coverage, notice, authorized viewing and retention. The cited source is limited to its stated public-body or institutional scope.
cctv.sourceTitle: OIPC Guidelines for Video Surveillance by Public Bodies in Newfoundland and Labrador

access.heading: Access control and life safety
access.body: Coordinate controlled entry/door hardware with applicable building and fire rules and safe egress; confirm requirements with the authority having jurisdiction.

intrusion.heading: Intrusion detection
intrusion.body: A site risk review can define monitored openings, zones, alarm handling and maintenance; source specifications are public-project examples, not universal mandates.
intrusion.sourceTitle: OIPC Guidelines for Video Surveillance by Public Bodies in Newfoundland and Labrador

remote.heading: Remote monitoring and escalation
remote.body: Document acknowledgment, contacts, escalation, communications resilience and incident records. Sources do not establish Fortega availability, coverage or response times.
remote.sourceTitle: OIPC Guidelines for Video Surveillance by Public Bodies in Newfoundland and Labrador

smart.heading: Smart-building energy
smart.body: Consider controls and energy management within applicable code and owner requirements. National model-code scope does not itself establish local adoption.
smart.sourceTitle: National Energy Code of Canada for Buildings: 2025

cyber.heading: Cybersecurity
cyber.body: Manage connected equipment with controlled accounts, updates, network safeguards, logging and incident planning. Government policy sources apply within their published scope.

consulting.heading: Risk planning and consulting
consulting.body: Plan against site-specific risks, privacy, life safety, operating workflows and system dependencies; this is planning guidance, not a claim of mandated consulting.
consulting.sourceTitle: OIPC Guidelines for Video Surveillance by Public Bodies in Newfoundland and Labrador

guards.heading: Guard services
guards.body: Specify scope, supervision, post orders, reporting and escalation. No claim about licensing requirements or current provider availability.
guards.sourceTitle: OIPC Guidelines for Video Surveillance by Public Bodies in Newfoundland and Labrador
